title: The combination of tetramethylpyrazine and vitamin A acid in the treatment of skin photoaging by activating the HIF-1alpha pathway.
authors: Chen, Weijun; Fan, Jianyong; Zou, Xuelian; Wu, Yuansheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究川芎嗪与维A酸通过HIF-1alpha通路治疗皮肤光老化，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Skin photoaging is a skin degenerative disease that causes patients to develop malignant tumors. The existing clinical treatment of photoaging has limitations. This greatly reduces the recovery rate of photoaging patients. Studies have confirmed that Ligusticum wallichii Franch (LWF) monomer tetramethylpyrazine (TMP) alleviates various skin diseases. The combination of traditional Chinese medicine and Western medicine helps with this process. Our research aimed to explore the specific treatment mode and molecular mechanism of TMP in treating skin photoaging. CCK-8 assays were used to evaluate the activity and toxicity of HaCaT cells. beta-galactosidase aging, Carbonyl compound and nitrosylated tyrosine assays were used to analyze the aging of HaCaT cells. ROS assays and ELISA were used to analyze the enrichment of ROS. The molecular docking experiment analyzed the binding of TMP and HIF-1alpha. qRT-PCR and Western blot were used to detect the activation of skin aging-related pathways. HE staining was used to analyze the thickness of the stratum corneum skin on the back skin of mice. 200mug/L LWF alleviates cellular photoaging and mouse skin photoaging by reducing ROS enrichment. Its monomer TMP plays an important role in this process. The combination of TMP and HIF-1alpha accelerates the degradation of ROS by activating the Nrf2/ARE signaling pathway. This process reduces the apoptosis of cells damaged by light. In addition, we also found that the combination of TMP and retinoic acid (RA) is more beneficial for the treatment of skin damage caused by light in mice. The combination therapy of TMP and RA alleviates skin oxidative stress response through overexpression of HIF-1alpha. This plan is beneficial for the treatment of skin photoaging.
abstract_zh: 皮肤光老化是一种导致患者发生恶性肿瘤的皮肤退行性疾病。现有的光老化临床治疗存在局限性，这大大降低了光老化患者的康复率。研究已证实，川芎 (Ligusticum wallichii Franch, LWF) 单体四甲基吡嗪 (tetramethylpyrazine, TMP) 可缓解多种皮肤病。中西医结合有助于这一过程。我们的研究旨在探讨TMP治疗皮肤光老化的具体治疗模式及分子机制。采用CCK-8实验评估HaCaT细胞的活性和毒性。使用β-半乳糖苷酶衰老、羰基化合物和硝基酪氨酸实验分析HaCaT细胞的衰老情况。通过ROS实验和ELISA分析ROS的富集。分子对接实验分析了TMP与HIF-1α的结合。采用qRT-PCR和Western blot检测皮肤衰老相关通路的激活。HE染色用于分析小鼠背部皮肤角质层的厚度。200μg/L LWF通过减少ROS富集缓解细胞光老化和小鼠皮肤光老化。其单体TMP在此过程中发挥重要作用。TMP与HIF-1α的结合通过激活Nrf2/ARE信号通路加速ROS降解。此过程减少了光损伤细胞的凋亡。此外，我们还发现TMP与维甲酸 (retinoic acid, RA) 的联合使用更有利于治疗小鼠光引起的皮肤损伤。TMP和RA的联合治疗通过过表达HIF-1α缓解皮肤氧化应激反应。该方案有利于皮肤光老化的治疗。
